description: Calculate a sourdough bread recipe in grams from loaf count, loaf size and hydration, with add-ins such as walnuts, raisins or seeds when the baker wants them. Returns flour, water, starter, salt and the add-ins, plus a link to the same recipe on loafy.ai where the baker can adjust it, bake it with "Bake this" and run the timers. Pizza dough is calculate_pizza_dough, and when to start a bake is plan_sourdough_bake. A value outside its range is corrected, and notes name it.

add_ins.description: Add-ins for the dough, comma-separated, each as its name and its share of the flour in percent, such as "walnuts 15, raisins 10"; grams with "g" ("walnuts 80 g") are for the whole batch, and a name without a number takes 10 %. Names from the list: walnuts, hazelnuts, sunflower_seeds, pumpkin_seeds, sesame, flaxseeds, hemp_seeds, poppy_seeds, raisins, cranberries, olives, cheese, sun_dried_tomatoes, chocolate; anything else in the baker's words.

flours.description: The flours, comma-separated, each as the baker named it with its share of all the flour in percent, such as "Caputo Pizzeria 70, whole rye 30": the brand and name on the bag, a token from find_flours, or the grain with the word on its bag. The first takes what the others leave. With flours, the whole grain follows from them and whole_grain_percent is not needed.

hydration_percent.description: Water as a percentage of flour. The book recommends around 60 % for most flours; higher is more open but stickier.

loaf_size_g.description: Flour per loaf in grams, not the dough weight: 500 g of flour makes one standard loaf of about 860 g of dough. For a loaf of a given dough weight, the flour is about 58 % of it at 60 % hydration.

whole_grain_percent.description: Share of the flour that is whole grain, the rest is bread flour.

name: calculate_bread_dough

outputSchema.description: A sourdough bread recipe in grams.

add_ins.description: What goes into the dough besides flour, water, starter and salt, such as walnuts or seeds.

grams.description: Its weight for the batch, in grams.

label.description: The baker's own add-in in their words.

name.description: The add-in: one of Loafy's names, or "other" for the baker's own.

note.description: Why its share is not the one asked for, when it is not.

percent.description: Its share of the flour, in percent.

dough_per_loaf_g.description: The dough of one loaf, in grams.

flours.description: The baker's own flours, when they were given.

name.description: The flour, as a bake's page names it.

share_percent.description: Its share of all the flour.

token.description: The flour from Loafy's list, as log_bake takes it.

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

total_dough_g.description: All the dough, the add-ins included, in grams.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Bread dough calculator
